rules.content:
/*
MindWare ransomware
*/

rule MindWare_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.mindware"
        description = "Detects MindWare ransomware ransom note"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $s1 = "MindWare" ascii nocase
        $s2 = "MINDWARE" ascii
        $s3 = ".mindware" ascii

    condition:
        any of them
}
